name: idiomatic-naming
description: Written during the adversarial audit from ordinary backend code, not from reading the analyzers. Every defect here was MISSED before 0.9.1: repository/client fields named after the domain rather than *Repo/prisma, multi-line SQL migrations, concatenated SQL, and a route whose public path is declared on the @Controller. The controls are the shapes that produced high-confidence false positives: a config map of environment-variable names, a header name, and a signature-verified webhook.

expected.why: findOne inside a for-of, same non-standard naming
multi-line ADD COLUMN NOT NULL with no default

controls.why: config map of environment-variable names, a header name and a dotted config key — none are credentials
public by necessity; the public segment is on the @Controller path
pool sized with an idle timeout
